name: Okita Nozomi
source:
Okita Nozomi is considered a master swordsman of Nippon. 
She's had martial talent from a young age. However, she has an introverted personality, is easily influenced, and has a propensity for being bullied.

[spoiler]The hannies took a liking to her and she was drawn into fighting as a member of the Shinsengumi. She suffers from Cough-Cough Disease, an illness that can be easily treated, but the hannies behave as if she's incurably ill.[/spoiler]

[From Rance Quest in-game content]

She resembles [url=/c8132]Takeda Nozomi[/url] from [url=/v298]Daiakuji[/url] and [url=/c38221]Takeda Nozomi[/url] from [url=/v3066]Daiteikoku[/url].
